scope: already-exposed development data and source semantics only; no candidate outcomes

legacy_parser_finding.interpretation: Historical page parsing proves parseability, not that the values equal the pre-race state at the original race time.

official_profile_semantic_finding.observed_semantics: score/win-rate/2-place-rate/3-place-rate and related statistics are displayed as rolling recent-four-month results with a current update timestamp
official_profile_semantic_finding.interpretation: Current profile values are time-varying and cannot be back-applied to an April race without a pre-race snapshot or a versioned as-of source.

source_admission_implication: A provider that supplies only present-day historical pages without versioned/as-of semantics cannot satisfy the frozen backbone's full Historical5000 PRE requirements.
